# Glossary

Alphabetical order. `→ chN` points to the chapter file. Entries marked (not expanded in the book) appear only in the book's type summary table, with no body text.

**Action** — the unit struct of the keyboard/command system, generated by the `actions!` macro under a namespace; bound to keystrokes via KeyBinding and to callbacks via on_action → ch11, ch02

**Animation** — configuration of duration + easing + whether to repeat; attached to elements via `with_animation` (AnimationExt) → ch09

**AnimationExt** — the trait providing `with_animation` (appears in the book only in example-code imports) → ch09

**App** — the application-wide state container; holder of the open_window / on_action / spawn / bind_keys / global method families → ch02, ch04

**AppContext** — trait; implemented by `App`, `Context<T>`, and others; derefs to App to access entities → ch03

**Application** — entry-point object; created with `new()`, started with `run(callback)` → ch02

**AsyncApp** — the parameter of `App::spawn`'s async closure; access to application state on the async side → ch02, ch13

**AsyncWindowContext** — async window context (not expanded in the book) → book type summary table

**BackgroundExecutor** — background-thread executor; spawn / timer → ch13

**ClickEvent** — the click-event parameter of on_click callbacks → ch10, ch14

**Context\<T\>** — Entity-specific context; derefs to App, and also provides `notify()` and more → ch02, ch03

**Deferred** — element that defers layout/paint; `with_priority` controls stacking order → ch05

**Div** — the most commonly used container element → ch05

**ElementId** — element identifier; the tracking key for interactive state and animation, must be stable across frames (interactive id and InteractiveText id are explicit in the book; the animation side is a generalization) → ch06, ch09, ch10

**Entity\<T\>** — GPUI-held state handle; when T: Render, it is a view → ch03

**FocusHandle** — focus handle; only after `track_focus` + `focus()` can element-level on_action receive actions → ch11

**ForegroundExecutor** — main-thread executor; blocking operations are forbidden → ch13

**Global** — marker trait for app-wide shared state → ch04

**ImageSource** — the conversion target type of `img()`'s argument (an enum); Path and others convert via `Into<ImageSource>` → ch05

**InteractiveElement** — stateless interaction trait (.id / key_context / track_focus / on_action) → ch10, ch11

**InteractiveText** — component for click/hover on text ranges → ch06

**KeyBinding** — binding of keystroke + action + key context; `KeyBinding::new` → ch11

**key context** — string context limiting the scope where key bindings take effect; elements declare it with `key_context()` → ch11

**keystroke modifiers** — ctrl / alt / shift / fn / cmd(super/win) / secondary → ch11

**Painter's algorithm** — paint-order rule where later painters cover earlier ones; deferred controls layering through it → ch05

**ParentElement** — trait providing `.child` / `.children` (appears in the book only in example-code imports) → ch05

**ReadGlobal / UpdateGlobal** — the traits behind the `T::global` / `T::set_global` / `T::update_global` convenience methods (appears in the book only in example-code imports) → ch04

**Render** — retained mode view trait; `&mut self + Context<Self>`; driven by notify → ch12

**RenderOnce** — immediate mode component trait; `self + App`; requires `#[derive(IntoElement)]` → ch12

**SharedString** — immutable string with cheap clone; render-friendly, replaces String → ch06

**SharedUri** — shared URI type (not expanded in the book) → book type summary table

**StatefulInteractiveElement** — stateful interaction trait (on_click / on_hover); requires `.id()` first → ch10

**StrikethroughStyle / UnderlineStyle** — style structs for strikethrough {thickness, color} / underline {thickness, color, wavy} → ch06, ch08

**Style** — the underlying style struct of elements; carries Taffy layout properties → ch07

**Styled** — element styling trait (`.style()` and the entry point of utility functions) → ch07

**StyledImage** — image styling trait (`.image_style()`: grayscale / object_fit / loading / fallback) → ch08

**StyledText / TextRun** — text component with per-range styling / range descriptor (len+font+color+background_color+underline+strikethrough, etc.) → ch06

**Subscription** — return value of `observe_global` and the like; must be held or `.detach()`ed → ch04

**Taffy** — GPUI's underlying layout engine (flexbox) → ch07

**Task\<T\>** — async task handle; dropping cancels it; `.detach()` lets it run → ch13

**TestAppContext** — test-only context (not expanded in the book) → book type summary table

**view** — the conventional name for an Entity\<T\> whose T implements Render → ch03, ch12

**WeakEntity** — the weak pointer from `entity.downgrade()` → ch03

**Window** — the platform window; `bounds()` / `mouse_position()` → ch02

**WindowOptions** — configuration parameter of `open_window` → ch02

**with_animation** — attaches animation with three parameters (id, Animation, delta closure) → ch09
